Totem Pole#001.src: A vision of the past presents itself to you...

Totem Pole#002.src: Even though you can clearly hear the tribesmen talking they appear to be speaking in a language you've never heard before.

Totem Pole#003.src: The sandstorm has been raging on for months, we HAVE to leave.
Totem Pole#003.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#004.src: We won't make it out there...
Totem Pole#004.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#005.src: We won't make it in here. We're almost out of food.
Totem Pole#005.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#006.src: Sandstorms usually only last days, maybe weeks. We must have upset the gods.
Totem Pole#006.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#007.src: I don't think so. I feel the lingering stench of betrayal in the air.
Totem Pole#007.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#008.src: This is a magical storm. We need to find a magical solution.
Totem Pole#008.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#009.src: Either way, we need to leave, or we're dead.
Totem Pole#009.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#010.src: I wonder what is happening out there in the citadel?
Totem Pole#010.speaker: Tribe Member

Totem Pole#011.src: It's a child's book. It's covered in pictures of sandstorms featuring some kind of stick.
